details.description: Amar Singh Chawal Wala proudly presents Lal Qilla Super Silverline Basmati Rice which is nourished and watered by snow-fed rivers. This class of Basmati rice gets better with ageing to enhance & intensify its taste, bouquet and cooking characteristics. This Super Silverline Basmati Rice is our guarantee for perfectly aged rice,extra-long grain with smooth texture and firmness. Aged Super Silverline Basmati Rice cooks fluffy with separate grains and is aromatic. What would delight you the most is the elongation of the grains after cooking which adds nourishment to every dish makes each meal a Royal feast.
details.usageInstructions:
COOKING METHOD:
Thoroughly rinse one cup of Lal Qilla basmati rice and soak for 30-35 minutes in lukewarm water.
Add soaked rice and salt to 2.5-3 cups of boiling water.
Cook on medium heat until the rice absorbs the water.
Cover with a tight lid and remove the pan from the fire.
Wait for 10-15 minutes and serve.
NOTE: If the cooked rice is too hard, then use more water in the next cooking and if the same is too soft, use less water.
MICROWAVE METHOD:
Place 1 cup of soaked Lal Qillla basmati Rice in a deep microwave container.
Add 2.5-3 of water and add salt if desired.
Cover container loosely with microwave cling film and cook on medium or 60% for 10-15 mins.
Allow standing time of 15 mins.
